faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Get your main questions answered before requesting a quote.
faq.1.q: How long until my site is ready to go live?
faq.1.a: Landing page in up to 7 days and corporate website in up to 10 days, counted from receiving your information (logo, photos, texts and contact details). Because I work with an optimized base structure, I deliver fast without compromising visual and technical quality.
faq.2.q: Will I be able to change texts and photos myself once the site is done?
faq.2.a: Yes, very easily. We build with the native WordPress editor (Gutenberg), with no dependence on complex systems. We also provide short video tutorials showing step by step how you or your team can update content in under 2 minutes.
faq.3.q: Why is your website faster than the competition?
faq.3.a: We build our sites with clean code and without piling on heavy plugins that slow the page down. A fast site loads instantly on your customer's phone (even on 4G), improves your Google ranking and keeps you from losing potential sales to slow loading.
faq.4.q: Are hosting and the domain already included in the price?
faq.4.a: Buying the domain (the .com.br address) and contracting hosting are done directly under your own CPF or CNPJ (Brazilian tax ID), so you are the sole owner of your data. We guide you through the whole process (which costs only a few reais per month) and handle the full technical setup at no extra cost.

guarantee.title: Hire with confidence
guarantee.lead: You know the price, the timeline and what is included before starting. And the site is 100% yours.
guarantee.1.title: Price agreed upfront
guarantee.1.text: A fixed price confirmed on WhatsApp before we start. No surprises along the way.
guarantee.2.title: Clear timeline
guarantee.2.text: 7 days for a landing page and 10 days for a corporate website, counted from receiving your information.
guarantee.3.title: Your domain and hosting
guarantee.3.text: Everything registered under your CPF or CNPJ. If you ever want to switch professionals, the site stays yours.
about.lead2: No middlemen: you talk directly to me, from the first contact until the site is live.
faq.5.q: How much does it cost? Is there anything hidden?
faq.5.a: Landing page from R$ 500 and corporate website (up to 4 pages) from R$ 800, with a floating button and WhatsApp calls to action. The contact form is optional and has an extra cost, agreed before we start. You pay the domain and hosting directly to the provider. Payment can be made via Pix, with a 50% deposit to start and 50% on delivery, or by credit card in up to 12 installments, with the interest paid by the customer.
